## Overview

This backward-compatible release adds completion notifications for PDF and PowerPoint exports
started from the MarkdStage VS Code extension. When an export finishes, VS Code offers actions to
open the saved file in its configured application or reveal it in the Explorer view. The feature
uses the compatible MarkdStage CLI and remains available alongside the existing preview,
presentation, validation, and Skill commands.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible. Existing Markdown decks, Canvas Extension installations, npm
CLI, and Desktop installations continue to work. The VS Code extension remains compatible with
MarkdStage CLI 4.4.0 and later within major version 4; export-completion notifications require
CLI 4.5.0 or later in the environment where the extension host runs.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.5.0`. |
| VS Code export notifications | Update the VS Code extension and MarkdStage CLI to 4.5.0 to receive export-completion notifications with Open and Reveal actions. |
